title: POST /api/v1/feed/resources request
description: What a machine and its Rakumux use now, for rtop on rakumux.com: the machine's CPU, memory and network, Rakumux's own processes by role, and each listed session's processes together. Sent only while rakumux.com wants it (a replies read's `resources_wanted`, then each answer's `wanted`), every few seconds; the cloud keeps only the latest per machine. Rates are the machine's own, from its last two readings. No process names, command lines, paths or pids: sessions are named by id, as the machine's session list names them, and only sessions that list has (never a private one).

host.description: The whole machine: how many CPUs, the busy share of all of them together, memory in use (total less available), and bytes a second over every interface but loopback. A part the machine can't read is absent.

rakumux.description: Rakumux's own processes, one item per role with how many processes have it: `server` (rakumux-ptyd), `window` (TUIs), `api` (rakumux-api), `account_service` (the status service) and `other` (CLI calls and anything else). Readers show a role they don't know as `other`.

sessions.description: Each running session the machine's session list has, its processes (the program its terminal started and every descendant) added together.

usage.description: What some processes use now: CPU as a percentage of one CPU (as `top` shows it: two busy CPUs are 200), resident memory, and bytes a second received and sent over their TCP connections (Linux only; absent where unknown). CPU is absent until two readings have it.
